'''Yasuhiro Takato''' (Japanese: '''高戸靖広''' ''Takato Yasuhiro'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Takato was born on January 23, 1968 in {{wp|Okayama}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|RS}}, voicing several characters, his most notable role being that of [[Tyson's Meowth]].
